title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator

The Role

The Payroll Administrator supports the Payroll Officer and Payroll Manager in the accurate and timely processing of payroll, ensuring all employees are paid correctly and statutory payroll obligations are met. The role is responsible for providing efficient administrative support to the payroll function, maintaining accurate records, and assisting with payroll-related queries. In addition, the postholder will provide cover and support across the team during periods of annual leave or absence to ensure the smooth and continuous operation of the department.

Key Responsibilities

P11d System
- Recording and maintenance of data held in the P11d system.
- Be the point of contact for both internal and external queries in relation to the system and the data within it.
- Provide the required monthly reports to Finance.
- Carry out any ad-hoc tasks in the system.
- Take ownership of the Van Declaration forms, ensuring they are received and recorded correctly.

WebExpenses
- Deal with the set-up of new user accounts.
- Maintain the data in the system to ensure accuracy (cost centre changes, approver changes, etc.).
- Clean the data in the system as a starting point to ensure correct recording going forward.
- Be the point of contact for account queries.

The Guild
- Collate the data and facilitate the payment of The Guild staff (CIS) each week.
- Produce the data for Finance and pass this over every week.
- Be the point of contact for The Guild and the people paid through them.

Court Order Payments
- Raise the payments each month for the court orders processed through the weekly and monthly payrolls.
- Ensure the records kept are accurate and up to date.

Other
- Cover the weekly payroll when the need arises.

Essential:
- Excellent time management skills and the ability to keep to deadlines in an often-challenging environment
- The ability to multi-task with excellent organisational skills
- Experience and proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- An eye for detail to ensure accuracy of all information
- Ability to work confidentially with sensitive information

Desireable:
- Previous experience of working within a payroll team.
- Be willing to learn and develop within a payroll environment.

Caring and investing in you

Our values have been embedded at Barhale for over 40 years, and they are our guiding principles regarding how we care and invest in people. Our values are our commitment to being a people-centric company.

As a Gold Investors in People company and a Sunday Times 100 Best Company to Work For, we are committed to investing in people. We are passionate about creating a working environment where people are supported throughout their careers, where people can enjoy security and be part of a company that cares about them.

From the moment you join us, your well-being and career aspirations will be supported by.
- Competitive salary
- Company Pension
- Life Assurance
- Private Medical
- 25 days of annual leave in addition to 8 public bank holidays and loyalty days
- 8 hours volunteering
- Employee Assistance Programme to support your mental, physiological and financial wellbeing
- Flexible benefits via salary sacrifice
- Company car/green car scheme/car allowance/Van (dependent on position)
- Leadership & management training and coaching
- Regular line management engagement and appraisal to support your career progression
- Development supported by internal and externally delivered training
- Continuous service awards

title: Account Assistant
description:

You must have experience working within a similar role along with excellent interpersonal skills and strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel. This is an office based role so would ideally suit someone who is local to West Bromwich.

title: Accounts Administrator
description:
The Role

The successful candidate will take responsibility for a broad range of transactional accounting duties, covering sales ledger, purchase ledger, credit control, banking, reconciliations and general accounts administration.

Working closely with the wider finance team and colleagues across the business, you will help ensure financial records are maintained accurately, transactions are processed efficiently and account queries are dealt with promptly.

Key Responsibilities

Sales Ledger & Credit Control
- Prepare, check and issue customer invoices against sales orders and delivery documentation.
- Maintain accurate customer accounts and sales ledger records.
- Monitor overdue payments and manage customer credit limits.
- Prepare customer statements and process authorised credit notes.
- Produce daily invoice uploads for the business's invoice-discounting facility.

Purchase Ledger
- Process supplier invoices, matching purchase orders and goods received notes where applicable.
- Investigate pricing, quantity and delivery discrepancies.
- Maintain accurate supplier records and purchase ledger accounts.

Banking & General Accounts
- Post and reconcile bank transactions using Sage 200.
- Update cash records and assist with routine cash-flow reporting.
- Reconcile company credit cards, petty cash and associated expenses.
- Prepare regular sales and purchase ledger reports.
- Assist with external audits and routine financial administration.

About You

Essential Requirements
- Previous experience in a transactional accounting, Accounts Technician or similar finance position.
- Good working knowledge of sales ledger, purchase ledger and credit control procedures.
- Experience preparing bank and supplier reconciliations.
- A good understanding of routine accounting principles and VAT.

Desirable Experience
- AAT qualified or currently studying towards an accounting qualification.
- Experience using Sage 200.
- Knowledge of invoice discounting or factoring arrangements.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
- Generous employer pension contributions.
- Death-in-service life assurance.

title: Billing Administrator
company: Pertemps Black Country Perms - Agency - Contract
description:
We are looking to recruit a Tenant and Billing Administrator to support the day-to-day administration of property, tenant and billing processes. The role involves maintaining accurate records, processing lease and tenancy changes, raising charges and invoices, and ensuring all work is completed accurately and within agreed deadlines.
This position is a 9-month fixed term contract.
The main duties are:
- Maintain accurate property and tenant records on the Horizon system.
- Process lease renewals, assignments, new licences, rent reviews and data amendments.
- Set up and manage diary events to support billing and lease processes.
- Prepare and process documentation for new properties, leases, renewals and amendments.
- Assist with preparing residential leases and licences.
- Prepare accurate completion statements for internal and external contacts.
- Calculate and raise charges in line with lease agreements and billing deadlines.
- Generate invoices on annual, quarterly and monthly billing cycles.
- Process regular recharges, including utilities, car parking, Sunday trading and purchase ledger costs.
- Process insurance invoices and raise the relevant charges.
- Issue service charge budgets, reconciliations and supporting documents.
- Check rent rolls, charges and system records, highlighting any errors or discrepancies.
- Ensure all changes and billing activities follow company procedures and controls.
- Deal with queries from tenants and colleagues, escalating more complex issues when needed.
- Work closely with Property Management, Finance and other departments to resolve queries and outstanding matters.
- Follow established processes and suggest ways to improve efficiency.

Skills and Experience
- Good communication skills and the ability to work with people at all levels.
- Able to manage a varied workload and work to tight deadlines.
- Good attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Confident using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- A positive and flexible approach with a willingness to learn.
- GCSEs (or equivalent) in English and Maths.
- Experience in Sales Ledger, Lease Management, Property Administration or Contract Management would be an advantage.

This is a great opportunity to work for a highly respectful company, they have so many benefits, including a subsidised canteen and a gym on site! 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
For the right person there is a possibility this role can lead to a permanent position.
